name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/widgets
description: Preact widgets for cgc-mdx pages, one subpath export each: `/pdf-viewer`. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist; the page's bundler (cgc-mdx) compiles it (ADR-0005). One subpath per widget and no root export, so one import never pulls in another widget (#36).
//sideEffects: A widget imports its own stylesheet for its side effect, which a bundler that honours this field (webpack) would drop under `false`. esbuild keeps CSS either way.
//dependencies: PDF.js is bundled into the widget's chunk, never fetched from a CDN. Pinned exactly: pdf-viewer.css carries PDF.js's text-layer rules, prefixed by hand, which must match the TextLayer that writes the markup.
//peerDependencies: The host's Preact: cgc-mdx pins every widget's preact imports to the host Quartz's copy, so one Preact per page.
//devDependencies: Types, and the CSS check the lint target runs.
